name: readthrough_candidates
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

inputs.role: which compounds have a prediction for this stop context and a passing control
the child's clinical terms as the adverse-effect axes they map to, used to decide which candidates collide with this child's own phenotype

rubric.0.8: measured in a living BubR1-deficient animal or in human MVA patient cells for this exact lever
rubric.0.6: model prediction for this child's exact stop context from a measured dataset whose declared positive control passed on both held-out sets
rubric.0.4: measured for this gene or protein but not for this allele, or a clinical-grade fact about the agent that bears on use
rubric.0.3: model prediction for this stop context whose positive control failed or was mixed: not interpretable as a number
rubric.0.2: mechanism-level rationale only, with no measurement in this gene
rubric.0.0: ruled out: regulatorily withdrawn, or predicted to act in the harmful direction

assumptions: a route is only as good as its positive control; a drug whose control failed is listed so that the failure is on the record, with evidence_strength at the rubric's 0.3 band
limitations: no readthrough or NMD-modulating agent has ever been tested in BUB1B/MVA, in a patient or in an animal model; every row is extrapolation from other nonsense-mutation diseases, and the notes say which
validation: positive_control_passed repeats the held-out control of the method behind the row; 'n/a' marks a literature statement, which no model produced

sources.genomic: the child's own callset, read only as: gene, consequence class, and the coding-sequence offset of the stop, which is used inside build/ to derive the codon and its context. No genomic position appears in any row
sources.clinical: the proband's 8 HPO terms (Challenge_Clinical_Phenotype_1.md), used to decide which adverse-effect axes disqualify a candidate: nephrocalcinosis HP:0000121 against aminoglycoside tubular nephrotoxicity, failure to thrive HP:0001508 and short stature HP:0004322 against chronic parenteral dosing, rhabdomyosarcoma HP:0002859 against agents whose class is cytotoxic or which stabilise oncogenic nonsense transcripts
sources.public: Ensembl REST release 116 (gene model, coding sequence), UniProt O60566 (domains), Toledano et al. Nat Genet 2024 PMID 39174735 supplementary table 3 (measured readthrough), and the BubR1 dosage literature cited per row

columns.branch: which allele or allele-state the row acts on: stop_allele, missense_unstable, missense_inactive, any
columns.evidence_kind: what kind of evidence stands behind the row, from the rubric in the entry
columns.evidence_strength: the rubric band in [0, 1]; a triage aid, not a probability
columns.positive_control_passed: true/false for a row whose number came from this route's model; n/a for a literature statement

clinical_framing: research exercise; no row advises for or against giving any drug to any patient
patient_data: none in this file. Sequence-derived facts are stated as codon identity, exon index, counts and fractions; no genomic position and no run of patient sequence appears
